full_repo_probe.summary: Indexed the parent repo, but scope-extraction warnings came from read-only files under external/.

fixture_probe.summary: Indexed an isolated parent-layer fixture cleanly without traversing read-only external authorities.

probe.summary: Bounded parent fixture updated cleanly with no LLM requirement and produced graphify-out/graph.json.
The package resolves locally and the parent doctrine map is present, but live MCP analysis remains API/OAuth-bound and was not faked without credentials.

dry_probe.summary: The parent-scoped fixture resolved locally, discovered the codex/docker experiment, and found the single parent-wrapper eval without making API calls.

smoke_probe.summary: The next stronger local lane is wired as a direct Codex smoke in Docker, but the run stopped closed because OPENAI_API_KEY was not configured.

agent_eval.runtime_boundary: Dry is the strongest honest local evidence in this run. The next stronger local smoke requires only OPENAI_API_KEY because the experiment is pinned to sandbox: docker; AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, VERCEL_TOKEN, and VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN are not required for that step.
